info.name: In Search of Its Rightful Owner

descriptions.notStarted: As soon as you reach Level 30, #b#p1201000##k strikes up a conversation with you…
descriptions.inProgress: #p1201000# tells you that the polearm is acting strange and that it might be trying to send you a message. You'd better head to #b#m140000000##k and check on the state of the #bpolearm#k.
descriptions.completed: Standing in front of the polearm is a strange-looking boy who you've never met before. Who is that? That kid does look a bit familiar. What? That boy is #p1201001#? No way…!
